result_text:
The three "latest orders" lists (overall, per region, per customer) now leave out archived orders as well as cancelled ones. The full offline test suite passes. I didn't add a test for your Alpha/Beta example, so that scenario hasn't been run.

All three lists go through one query builder, `SalesOrderQuery.latest(int)` in `DataStore.java`. I added the existing "not archived" condition there, and updated its doc comment.

The doc comments on `findLatestSalesOrders`, `findLatestSalesOrdersInRegion` and `findLatestSalesOrdersOfCustomer` still say only "cancelled ones left out". My attempt to update them was blocked, so I left them.
